title: Terra, Sol, and Variable-Depth Route Prefixes
negative_results: an unknown namespace is refused unless allow_custom=True
an uppercase or non-identifier namespace is refused
a d<depth> token that disagrees with the segment count is refused
a missing colon, missing depth token, or bad depth token is refused
a route segment with whitespace or a delimiter is refused
a vector containing the prefix delimiter is refused

claims.statement: A namespace (terra:/sol:) and a variable-depth route path (d<N>/seg.../) label a CW vector and round-trip through format/parse and wrap/split; strip() and rewrap() recover the underlying numeric address byte-for-byte (POWER: label-only, numeric address never changes across namespaces).
A malformed namespace, depth, or route path is a typed refusal, never a silent guess.

privacy_check: CLEAN - label-only string logic on synthetic vectors, no private inputs
